discription: A bright, slightly detuned pulse wave lead sound with a fast attack and moderate decay/release ADSR envelope. It uses two detuned Pulse oscillators and a dynamic low-pass filter.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, pulseWidth=0.5, detune=1.005, cutoffMod=1;var sig, env, filterCutoff;env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.01, 0.2, 0.7, 0.8, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2);filterCutoff = LfNoise1.ar(freq * 0.1).range(freq * 1.5, freq * 4) + (env * 2000 * cutoffMod).clip(freq, 20000);sig = (Pulse.ar(freq, pulseWidth) + Pulse.ar(freq * detune, pulseWidth)) * 0.5;sig = LPF.ar(sig, filterCutoff);Out.ar(out, sig * amp * env ! 2);}
